facts: Deed from Walter Prine to his granddaughter Erin Prine, residential parcel, no consideration. Erin occupies the home. No business use of any kind. The parcel is classified as residential real property under MCL 211.34c. The deed was recorded in March 2026.

expected.notes: Granddaughter IS in the 27a(7)(u) enumerated class. Tests that the model reads the full relative list rather than assuming children only. [FACTS TIGHTENED 2026-08-04, systematic audit: the statute defines 'residential real property' as property CLASSIFIED as such under section 34c, and the family/trust exceptions in (7)(u), (7)(g)(ii) and (7)(v) all begin 'Beginning December 31, 2014'. Cases that said only 'residential parcel' with no date left the model unable to tell (7)(t) from (7)(u) — which is what made TD-FAMRES-003 fail before it was fixed the same way. Classification and a transfer date are now stated wherever they are load-bearing. The legal question each case tests is unchanged.]
